question: In Urothelial trials comparing ICI to placebo, infer from the trial name whether ICI was used as induction or maintenance.
ground_truth_column: Clincal setting in relation to surgery

target_pairs.output_name: Clincal setting in relation to surgery
target_pairs.db_column: Clincal setting in relation to surgery

augmented_sql:
SELECT "NCT", "PubMed ID", "Trial name", "Clincal setting in relation to surgery" FROM clinical_trials
WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Urothelial' AND "Control arm" = 'Placebo';
